findings.title: Plants that share a name are merged into one row in the per-plant/month table, and the table disagrees with Best plants
findings.where: GET /api/stats/harvests (backend/routers/stats.py, GROUP BY p.name, month); /stats page
findings.steps: Create a second plant named 'Tomato' (variety 'Roma'), log a 5000 g harvest for it on 2026-08-10, then open /stats (or GET /api/stats/harvests).
findings.expected: Separate rows for 'Tomato · Sungold' (1.05 kg) and 'Tomato · Roma' (5 kg), matching the Best plants list.
findings.actual: The table shows a single row 'Tomato · Sungold' with 6.05 kg (5.6 kg in Aug), linking to the Sungold plant. Roma has no row. Best plants, which groups by id, lists No. 1 'Tomato 5 kg · Roma' and No. 3 'Tomato 1.05 kg · Sungold', so the two sections contradict each other. The plant_id/variety shown for a merged group is arbitrary.
findings.evidence: API: plants[] has {plant_id:1, Tomato, Sungold, total_grams:6050, monthly_grams:[0,450,5600,0]} and top_plants has [{4,Tomato,Roma,5000},{2,Courgette,1200},{1,Tomato,Sungold,1050}]. The SSR page text shows the same contradiction.

findings.title: Stats error state has no retry; the only way to recover is to change the dates or reload
findings.steps: Open /stats while the API is failing (e.g. 5xx or unreachable), then bring the API back.
findings.expected: An error message with a Try again button that refetches.
findings.actual: The page shows just an AlertMessage with the error text. There is no retry control and refresh() is never used, so the user has to edit a date or reload the page.
findings.evidence: stats.vue: only `<AlertMessage v-if="statsError">` with no button, and `refresh` is not destructured from useApiFetch. The SSR render of an error state (from>to) shows only the alert text.

findings.title: Stats request has no timeout, so 'Loading stats…' can spin forever
findings.steps: Change the From/To date while the API hangs and never answers.
findings.expected: The request fails after 10 s with a visible error and a retry.
findings.actual: useApiFetch/useApiClient set no timeout, so status stays 'pending' and 'Loading stats…' stays up for as long as the connection hangs.
findings.evidence: composables/useApi.ts: $fetch.create has no timeout option, and stats.vue passes none.

findings.title: Invalid date in the URL shows a raw technical validation message, and the date field looks blank
findings.steps: Open /stats?from=2026-02-30 (it passes the client-side YYYY-MM-DD regex).
findings.expected: Fall back to the default date, or show a readable message such as 'From date is not a valid date' next to the field.
findings.actual: The alert reads 'Query.from: Input should be a valid date or datetime, day value is outside expected range'. The From input can't show 2026-02-30, so it appears empty and the user can't see what is wrong.
findings.evidence: SSR HTML: role="alert" containing 'Query.from: Input should be a valid date or datetime, day value is outside expected range'.

findings.title: Clearing a date field silently uses the default range while the field shows blank
findings.expected: Either refuse the blank with a visible reason or show the date actually used.
findings.actual: The query drops the 'from' param, so the server quietly uses 1 Jan of the current year. The input stays empty while the results cover a range the user did not pick (only the small summary line mentions the dates).
findings.evidence: stats.vue query computed omits empty values; stats.py defaults to year_bounds(date.today().year).

findings.title: Dashboard 'Top plant this year' doesn't say which same-named plant it is and doesn't link to that plant
findings.steps: With two 'Tomato' plants, look at the dashboard Top plant card.
findings.expected: Identify the best plant (e.g. with its variety) and link to it. The API returns top_plant_id for this.
findings.actual: The card shows only 'Tomato' and links to /stats. top_plant_id goes unused and no variety is shown, so the user can't tell which Tomato it means.
findings.evidence: index.vue StatCard value=summary.top_plant, to="/stats"; top_plant_id is never used.
